name: @davidacres/praxis-addon-security-review
description: Whole-codebase security review workflow: a severity-ranked report with structured findings and, on approval, a prioritised remediation plan created on the project board.

praxis.name: Security Review
praxis.summary: Maps the attack surface, runs Semgrep, Gitleaks and OSV-Scanner when installed, and writes a severity-ranked report with structured findings. Approve to create a P0–P3 remediation plan on your board, or skip. macOS/Linux.
